summary: Stocks are lower Thursday afternoon. Chipmakers are selling off on AI caution, and a jump in oil is adding pressure across markets.
market_note: S&P futures down 0.65%, Nasdaq futures down 1.53%: a risk-off tilt into the close.

items.why: Oil surged on a report of Iran strike plans, per CoinDesk, and Bloomberg says the oil jump is pressuring both stocks and bonds.
Chip stocks are selling off after the Financial Times reported OpenAI's annualized revenue is about $20B below earlier signals, rattling AI-linked names.
Down with the chip complex as AI caution spreads; Yahoo's midday note flags the chip-led drag on the Nasdaq.
Bitcoin fell as oil jumped on the Iran strike-plan report, with spot ETF outflows and heavy long liquidations adding pressure.
